Humaan Studio 0.1.0-alpha.1

Early alpha baseline in humaan-ai/humaan. Back up project directories before upgrading; interfaces and data formats may change.

Available workflows
- Create and reopen local version 1 projects, browse and edit project files, and import URDF robots and meshes.
- Assemble robots in Builder, inspect physical properties, and save immutable versions.
- Install a managed MuJoCo runtime, simulate fixed-base robots, and replay saved results.
- Inspect and curate recordings and organize experiences and learning sets.
- Train and evaluate limited joint-feedback controllers locally or on an existing SSH host; register policies and record compatible robot assignments.
- Visualize read-only robot telemetry through an external local bridge and save joint-position sessions for playback.
- Check for newer Studio releases and open the matching download. Installation remains manual.

Downloads and compatibility
- macOS: Apple Silicon app archive and DMG. Release builds require Developer ID signing and Apple notarization.
- Linux: x86-64 DEB and AppImage. Runtime compatibility depends on the distribution.
- Windows: x86-64 NSIS installer. Windows installers are unsigned.
- Check the accompanying SHA-256 manifests before installation.
- The CLI is distributed separately under cli-v0.1.0-alpha.1.

Known limitations
- Simulation and training require MuJoCo; managed setup needs internet access. Simulation supports a fixed root and limited joint/collision models, and does not enforce hardware velocity limits.
- Training optimizes a joint-feedback controller, not a neural policy or demonstration-based model. Simulation results do not establish hardware safety or task success.
- Policy registration and assignment do not execute policies on hardware. Live Link is read-only; hardware adapters and calibration require separate validation.
- Live Link sessions contain joint positions and local receipt timestamps, not synchronized camera data or hardware acquisition timestamps. Stop and save before closing the application.
- RunPod provisioning is an initial integration. Live provider boot, billing deadlines, result retrieval, and cleanup still require funded-account validation. Provisioned resources can incur charges.
- Provider-backed chat, catalog downloads, hardware policy execution, project-format v2, and automatic update installation are not included.
- Preserve existing project directories when upgrading. Historical releases belong to the archived repository; this release establishes the new repository baseline.
